ServiceCloud.title: Cloud
ServiceCloud.lead: Systems running on the right amount of cloud for your business — without paying for capacity you don't use.

sections.title: What's included
sections.body: Choosing and configuring cloud providers, migrating on-premise systems, and tuning costs so the monthly bill actually matches real usage.

sections.title: When it makes sense
sections.body: When the company wants to scale without investing in its own servers, or when it's already on the cloud but paying more than it should due to poor configuration.

examples: Cutting costs on providers you already use
ServiceCloud.ctaTitle: Is your operation ready for the cloud?
ServiceCloud.ctaBody: We assess the current setup and show the simplest path forward — even if that means staying as you are.
